name: What are the unique historical sites to explore in Palm Beach?

mainEntity.name: What are the unique historical sites to explore in Palm Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond the Flagler Museum, Palm Beach offers other unique historical sites. The historic neighborhoods showcase diverse architectural styles from the early 20th century. Bethesda-by-the-Sea Episcopal Church is a beautiful landmark with significant historical value and stunning architecture. The John D. MacArthur Beach State Park also has a fascinating natural history and preserves a portion of barrier island habitat. When exploring historical sites, consider if you prefer self-guided walking tours of historic districts or more structured museum experiences to best tailor your visit to your interests in the area's rich past.
